description: Evaluation questions over the files in samples/. A retrieved chunk is a hit when it contains `evidence` (whitespace-normalised, case-insensitive) and, for PDFs, comes from one of `pages`. `answer_facts` must all appear in the generated answer; `a|b` accepts either form. Questions with `source: null` are not answered by any document and must get the insufficient-evidence reply.

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave does a full-time employee get?
questions.evidence: entitled to 20 days of paid annual leave

questions.question: How many unused holiday days can I move into next year, and by when do I have to use them?
questions.evidence: Up to 5 unused days can be carried over into the next year

questions.question: When do I need a doctor's note for being off sick?
questions.evidence: A medical certificate is required for any absence longer than 3 consecutive working days

questions.question: How long is the paid leave for the main carer of a newborn baby?
questions.evidence: primary caregiver of a new child is entitled to 16 weeks

questions.question: What do I get if I am asked to work on a public holiday?
questions.evidence: receive a replacement day off within the following 30 days

questions.question: How many days a week am I allowed to work from home?
questions.evidence: work remotely for up to 2 days per week

questions.question: How much weight do I need to lose to noticeably improve my blood glucose?
questions.evidence: Losing even 5-10% of your body weight

questions.question: Can type 2 diabetes go into remission, and how much weight loss does that take?
questions.evidence: than 15 kg of their body weight can put their type 2 diabetes into remission

questions.question: How much of my plate should be vegetables or salad?
questions.evidence: Aim for ½ of your plate to be vegetables or salad

questions.question: How many calories are in a pint of beer or a glass of wine?
Why should people with diabetes avoid smoked salmon?
questions.evidence: smoked salmon or gravlax due to an increased risk from listeriosis

questions.question: How much exercise per week is recommended for someone with type 2 diabetes?
questions.evidence: 150 minutes of moderate intensity activity over a week

questions.question: What is the most saturated fat an average woman should eat in a day?
questions.evidence: The average woman should have no more than 20g saturated fat a day

questions.question: What is the maximum amount of salt an adult should eat per day?
questions.evidence: Adults should eat no more than 6g of salt a day

questions.question: Should I take vitamin D in winter, and how much?
questions.evidence: daily supplement containing 10 micrograms of vitamin D during autumn and winter

questions.question: What is the weekly alcohol limit for men and women?
questions.evidence: no more than 14 units per week

questions.question: I eat a lot of red meat. How much should I cut down to each day?
questions.evidence: try to cut down to no more than 70g per day
